d: From Europe’s escalating protests and travel advisories to Donald Trump’s viral comments on a Republican Senate candidate, Firstpost examines the impact of unrest on tourism, French President Emmanuel Macron’s crackdown, and the protests planned for October 24. Hem Kaur Saroya also decodes Trump’s controversial campaign style and whether his remarks about men’s bodies could influence the upcoming US midterm elections. Hem Kaur Saroya tells you more.
